display_method.held_out_ranges: unconnected per-radius range bars; no continuous extremal envelope
display_method.kind: fixed-sub-error-RMS quadratic curvature regularisation of displayed nodes, followed by a shape-preserving PCHIP curve
display_method.selection: lambda selected by monotone L2 bisection for target RMS 0.20 times the declared display tolerance; lambda is halved conservatively if the componentwise or positivity gate would fail; topology is a separate fail-closed gate
display_method.source_nodes: retained as faint unconnected open markers
